entries.title: Howl at the Moon
entries.desc: Proper Irish pub on Hoxton Street itself, with Irish trad sessions and reliably good Guinness.

entries.title: The Joiners Arms
entries.desc: Irish pub right on Denmark Hill with a lively live-music scene and a rooftop terrace.

entries.title: The Crown
entries.desc: Traditional boozer on Hackney Central's main street, kept as old-school as London pub culture gets.

entries.title: The Crown and Shuttle
entries.desc: Victorian Shoreditch institution turned craft beer pub, right by the station.

entries.title: The Hawke
entries.desc: Pub on the Victoria Park side of Homerton, run by a landlord who treats the drinks list like an art project.

entries.title: The Victoria Tottenham
entries.desc: Mid-1800s pub near the Spurs stadium, a proper local through the area's redevelopment.

entries.title: The Royal Oak Highams
entries.desc: Converted former cottage that kept its Edwardian features, out toward Woodford Green.
entries.address: 320 Hale End Road, Woodford Green IG8 9LN

entries.title: The Lock Inn
entries.desc: Canalside pub by the Olympic Park with a rotating line-up of craft beer and a properly tranquil waterside spot.
